correctness.rationale: All R-section maps fix the selected constant image r. In a band, adjacent collapse representatives are idempotents whose L/R directions must alternate, since two successive collapses pointing the same way have a nonidempotent product. Three successive points beyond r produce an idempotent block-collapse h and e at the distal adjacent edge such that h e has a two-step orbit, contradiction. This proves the global n>=6 cutoff. For allowed r the explicit maps split into two bands Q_0,Q_1,Q_2 whose multiplication is directly checked. Different interval kernels index all 2^(n-1) representatives and uniqueness follows by multiplication with e_i. Executed staged standalone verification: VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Band R-cross-sections are a natural strengthening of Green representative subsemigroups: every representative must be a retraction. The theorem gives a sharp five-point existence boundary throughout an infinite family, a complete labeled classification, and isomorphism decompositions; the nonexistence proof uses a structural four-point obstruction rather than arbitrary small enumeration.
